text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PDR-5421 routing-latency-high (router-group-eu-west). Trigger: 95th latency > 600ms for 5m. https://pagerduty.example/PDR-5421 @oncall paging.

marta: ack @incident-bot I'll take it. :wave:

incident-bot: Ack recorded by marta

luis: checking metrics — short spike across 3 router nodes, ~1m duration, partial recovery after. No increase in 5xx client errors. Suspect KV-cache warmup or autoscaler jitter.

ben: looking at router logs, seeing repeated 502s from backend pool A in the same window. running quick tail: 

ben: ```bash
kubectl -n inference logs router-5f7 --since=10m | rg "502" | head -n 5
# 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z router-5f7 backendA 502
# 2026-03-15T14:02:15Z router-5f7 backendA 502
```

marta: hmm. throughput didn't spike so not a capacity exhaustion. could be routing table flap or backend instability. can we failover a sliver of traffic to fallback-eu for a minute? @ops-bot please runbook: reroute-to-fallback (small %).

ops-bot: Executing runbook: reroute-to-fallback
ops-bot: ```
runbook: reroute-to-fallback --cluster router-eu --to fallback-eu --percent 5 --dry-run=false
status: success
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert PDR-5421 escalated to ben (oncall) due to no-update after 5m

ben: on it. flipping fallback now.

ops-bot: traffic rerouted: 5% -> fallback-eu. Observing latencies...

luis: metrics update: 95p latency down from ~620ms to ~240ms within 30s of reroute. error rate stable. looks like transient routing flap.

marta: keeping watch for 10m then will unroute. any customer impact seen?

ben: checked support dashboard & alerting — no customer tickets or visible user errors. marking no-impact for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Alert PDR-5421 auto-resolved (duration 3m 12s). PagerDuty status: resolved by system (auto-resolve).

marta: noted it auto-resolved while we were mid-mitigation. we should reduce noise — plan: tune routing-latency alert to use percentage delta and add short synthetic canary to detect flapping.

luis: logged follow-up: ISSUE-2234 — create eu routing canary, tune 95p threshold to relative increase, add PD suppression for duplicate chains.

ben: reverting fallback now and will monitor for recurrence. ops-bot: revert-reroute please.

ops-bot: revert completed. traffic back to normal distribution.

marta: closing thread — outcome: quick rollback/reroute mitigated impact, no customer-facing incidents, PD auto-resolved. follow-ups assigned: ISSUE-2234 (canary, alert tuning, PD suppression). thanks everyone :tada:
